caption:
Google recalibrated how it ranks local businesses in 2026, according to marketing analysts tracking Google Business Profile activity.

Interactions now count alongside reputation. How often people call you, view your photos, or open your Update posts factors into your local ranking.

The new baseline: profiles posting an Update at least twice a week are treated as active and rank higher for it.

Here's what owners miss. A better rank sends more calls to your phone. That only becomes revenue if someone answers fast enough to book the job.

rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience news, and this interprets a genuinely current 2026 Google Business Profile ranking shift (interaction/popularity signals, twice-weekly Update posting) through Black Arrow's unclaimed follow-up thesis: a ranking boost is wasted without fast response.
